scientific_question: At the same physical station and nearly equal astronomical daylength, does the detected diel-time distribution of each of four ungulate taxa differ between the lengthening and shortening parts of the year, after separately confirming camera operating-time exposure?
null_invariance: For each species and station, the conditional solar-phase clock-time detection density is invariant between matched-length ascending and descending photoperiod days.
alternative_hysteresis: An explicitly observed rising/falling photoperiod-branch effect is needed to predict heldout detections even after astronomical geometry, but is not a causal temperature or photoperiod-memory claim.

preoutcome_structural_pairing.pair_algorithm: globally sort all eligible (abs(daylength difference),ascending_date,descending_date) triples and greedily accept pairs without replacement
preoutcome_structural_pairing.sunrise_sunset_definition: NOAA apparent zenith=90.833°, fractional-year declination approximation at local noon

preoutcome_feasibility_gates.allowable_claim: descriptive/predictive transport conditional on UJ1 and UJ2; no iid two-region generalization

predictive_plan_outline.same_outcome: continuous civil local-time density log score per independent ungulate event, with solar-to-clock Jacobian
candidates: solar-phase density conditional on rising vs falling daylength by species
predictive_plan_outline.baseline: both candidates trained only from separate site-fold, with identical kernel/regularization rule fixed using training-only data
predictive_plan_outline.heldout_unit: entire original camera station, nested within UJ1 or UJ2
predictive_plan_outline.matched_comparison: one-to-one public-astronomy matched photoperiod dates; compare branch effect at sites with operating exposure, report descriptive site-based scores
predictive_plan_outline.scientific_success_requires: outcome-blind source provenance, independently defined operational effort and a fresh frozen outcome scoring plan; not established in this structural stage

hard_stops: No raw EcoBank detection/event CSV opened by structural date-pair stage
No synthetic date-pair matching rule tuned to animal event or score values
No claim all 82 stations are iid across landscapes; only two region clusters
No inference of hourly effort from functional nights alone
No selection on animal detection occurrence to form station roster
No source-independent operation-log claim based only on file name
If exact EcoBank archive URL/bytes or legal access unavailable, return source-unavailable rather than substitute an article screenshot
No previous RI result or qualified ODSP route reclassified
